title: Some users' Microsoft 365 apps may not appear in the App launcher in SharePoint Online
impact: Users' Microsoft 365 apps may not appear in the App launcher in SharePoint Online.

updates.content:
Title: Some users may not see apps in the Microsoft 365 app launcher when accessed through SharePoint Online

User impact: Users may not see apps in the Microsoft 365 app launcher when accessed through SharePoint Online.

More info: Users may also not see the Gear icon for settings in SharePoint Online.
 
As a workaround, affected users can access the affected apps directly through office.com or microsoft365.com.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the root cause and determine our next troubleshooting steps. 

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users in Europe, Middle East, Africa, and the United States regions attempting to access apps through the Microsoft 365 app launcher in SharePoint Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at 3:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users may not see apps in the Microsoft 365 app launcher when accessed through SharePoint Online

User impact: Users may not see apps in the Microsoft 365 app launcher when accessed through SharePoint Online.

More info: Users may also not see the Gear icon for settings in SharePoint Online.
 
As a workaround, affected users can access the affected apps directly through office.com or microsoft365.com.

Current status: We’ve identified that requests used to display Microsoft 365 app launcher information are failing with an HTTP 500 Internal Server error response. We suspect this is related to a resource constraint affecting the supporting service infrastructure, where increased resource utilization is causing requests to be rejected. We’re working to increase the available infrastructure capacity to mitigate the underlying issue and restore app launcher functionality. 

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users in Europe, Middle East, Africa, and the United States regions attempting to access apps through the Microsoft 365 app launcher in SharePoint Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 4:30 PM UTC

Title: Some users' Microsoft 365 apps may not appear in the App launcher in SharePoint Online

User impact: Users' Microsoft 365 apps may not appear in the App launcher in SharePoint Online.

More info: Users may not have the Settings icon, also known as the gear icon, appearing in SharePoint Online.

As a workaround, affected users can access the affected apps directly through office.com or microsoft365.com.

Current status: We've further identified that a portion of the SharePoint Online service infrastructure is operating in a suboptimal state and causing requests from SharePoint Online to the Microsoft 365 app launcher to time out, resulting in impact. We're implementing optimizations to increase the processing functionality of the affected infrastructure and return it to expected functionality. We'll aim to provide a timeline for our optimizations to be implemented by our next scheduled communications update.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users in Europe, Middle East, Africa, and the United States regions attempting to access apps through the Microsoft 365 app, or the Setting page, in SharePoint Online. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Monday, October 5, 2026, at 12:30 PM UTC

Root cause: A portion of the SharePoint Online service infrastructure is operating in a suboptimal state and causing requests related to the Microsoft 365 app launcher to time out, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC
